title: routing::extract_message_id is dead code — confusing future contributors
description: extract_message_id is pub, has tests, but is never called from any other module (not in lib.rs re-exports, not called from session.rs or main.rs). A contributor seeing this function would assume it's part of the routing API contract and avoid removing it, or write new code calling it unnecessarily. Scenario: contributor adds deduplication logic using extract_message_id instead of looking at how routing actually works. Maintenance consequence: accumulating orphaned surface area. Fix: either use it or remove it. If it's being kept for a future epic, document that explicitly with a comment referencing the issue.
